description: A right expander for BZ-XPAND, going immediately to the right of it, which scales and offsets each of the CV inputs that expander adds to the nodes and control points of BZ-MAPPER

params.text: Scales the voltage at the horizontal CV input for that node or control point
Offsets the voltage at the horizontal CV input for that node or control point
Scales the voltage at the vertical CV input for that node or control point
Offsets the voltage at the vertical CV input for that node or control point

notes: the chain runs BZ-MAPPER, then BZ-XPAND, then this module, each immediately to the right of the one before; the voltages it scales and offsets are the ones arriving at BZ-XPAND's inputs.
BZ-ENVELOPE takes this pair of expanders in the same way as BZ-MAPPER.
